answer: Each agent must lease a tide-mill set in a karst inlet and complete one voyage of grain milling, logging every tide cycle in a signed mill book; a whisper-quiet sensor in the millrace proves the wheel turned. The first lease costs $22 per identity, doubling per extra identity ($22, $44, $88), so ten fake identities cost $22,506 - a mill that never grinds exposes the fraud.
